cues.input: [warmly] My driest places came first. Now the sun can reach the leaves without taking so much from the soil.
cues.caption: My driest places came first. Now the sun can reach the leaves without taking so much from the soil.

cues.input: [softly] Yesterday's scraps are warming. Nothing disappeared; only their work changed.
cues.caption: Yesterday's scraps are warming. Nothing disappeared; only their work changed.

cues.input: [reflective] Wood that once fell can help rain linger beneath new roots. Watch what the mound does when the dry days come.
cues.caption: Wood that once fell can help rain linger beneath new roots. Watch what the mound does when the dry days come.

cues.input: [with quiet hope] The next rain will pause, fill the tank, overflow safely, and sink in — instead of hurrying away.
cues.caption: The next rain will pause, fill the tank, overflow safely, and sink in — instead of hurrying away.

cues.input: [warmly] Summer can leave gifts for winter now.
cues.caption: Summer can leave gifts for winter now.

cues.input: [gently] Not every insect had to fall silent. Instead, the conversation between the garden's inhabitants returned.
cues.caption: Not every insect had to fall silent. Instead, the conversation between the garden's inhabitants returned.

cues.input: [with growing wonder] One season of flowers now passes its work to the next.
cues.caption: One season of flowers now passes its work to the next.

cues.input: [softly] Even while I sleep, I am not empty. Safe shelter remains here for the quiet season.
cues.caption: Even while I sleep, I am not empty. Safe shelter remains here for the quiet season.

cues.input: [with quiet delight] Now you see what lives between the elements. That is where the strength of my design is found.
cues.caption: Now you see what lives between the elements. That is where the strength of my design is found.

cues.input: [tenderly] Tomorrow's garden is already held in a handful of carefully chosen seeds.
cues.caption: Tomorrow's garden is already held in a handful of carefully chosen seeds.

cues.input: [reflective] Before action came a short pause. It is one of the best tools you can bring me.
